answer: A bond is refunded only after 45 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The glacier counter is kept in quartz and voyage reveals each reset. An attacker as a result has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 45 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Repeating the trick 36 times costs 51 separate deposits and 25 separate proofs of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
